example.en: After the fire in the building, business proceeded as usual.
example.zh: 建築失火之後，業務仍照常進行。

example.en: The largest banquet room of our hotel can accommodate 500 guests.
example.zh: 本旅館最大的宴會廳可以容納 500 名賓客。

example.en: It is essential that all employees perform their contractual obligations.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須履行合約義務。

example.en: Many companies are undergoing great hardships in these difficult economic times.
example.zh: 許多公司在這段景氣蕭條時期經歷重重難關。

example.en: One of the challenges for managers is to evaluate employees fairly.
example.zh: 主管階層的其中一項挑戰就是要公平考核員工。

example.en: The city officials were asked to assess the damage caused by the earthquake.
example.zh: 市府官員被要求評估地震造成的損失。

example.en: We plan to demonstrate our new printer at several electronics stores.
example.zh: 我們計畫在幾間電器用品店展示我們的新型印表機。

example.en: The rival firms decided to collaborate in order to increase business.
example.zh: 兩家競爭公司決定合作以拓展事業。

example.en: Sam asked his company to reimburse him for travel expenses.
example.zh: 山姆向公司請款差旅費用。

example.en: The workers stacked products on the warehouse shelves.
example.zh: 員工把產品堆放在倉庫的貨架上。

example.en: The firm facilitated cooperation among its branches through regular meetings.
example.zh: 公司透過定期會議促進各分公司之間的合作。

example.en: The office has been more comfortable ever since it was renovated.
example.zh: 辦公室經過整修之後變得更加舒適。

example.en: I've compiled data that might be helpful to you.
example.zh: 我匯集了可能對你有幫助的數據。

example.en: Elaine browsed the items in several fashion stores.
example.zh: 依蓮在時裝店裡四處看看。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 確保安全；保護 / 形 安全的

example.en: I've secured Meeting Room C for our brainstorming session.
example.zh: 我已經為我們腦力激盪會議訂好 C 會議室了。

example.en: Mr. Kim must obtain a visa before coming to work at our firm.
example.zh: 金先生來我們公司上班之前必須取得簽證。

example.en: Rita used historical quotes to illustrate her seminar points.
example.zh: 瑞塔引用歷史名言來闡明她的專題討論重點。

example.en: Pam clarified her plans for the building project during the meeting.
example.zh: 潘在會議上闡明她的建設企劃案。

example.en: It is necessary to modify the plan so that all parties agree.
example.zh: 必須修改計畫才能取得各方同意。

example.en: The moderator allotted 30 minutes to each speaker at the conference.
example.zh: 會議主持人分配給每位講者 30 分鐘的發言時間。

example.en: Analysts are assuming that inflation will rise over the next quarter.
example.zh: 分析師認為下一季的通貨膨脹率將上升。

phrases.phrase: owe A B = owe B for/to A

example.en: We owe the maintenance company for services rendered.
example.zh: 我們還欠維修公司一筆服務費用。

example.en: Engineers are now investigating the cause of the system shutdown.
example.zh: 工程師正在調查系統停止運作的原因。

example.en: The shop owner hadn't anticipated a crowd of people on opening day.
example.zh: 店主並未預料到開幕當天會有那麼多人來。

example.en: The station manager assured us that the train would be on time.
example.zh: 站長向我們保證火車一定會準點抵達。

example.en: The employee's union is comprised of 150 members.
example.zh: 該工會由 150 名成員所組成。

example.en: Employees from eight different countries constitute the design team.
example.zh: 來自 8 個不同國家的員工組成這個設計團隊。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 制定，建立 / 名 學會；研究機構

example.en: The personnel department will institute a new rule that will cut down on employee tardiness.
example.zh: 人事部門將制定一條新規定以減少員工遲到的情形。

example.en: Emergency lights in the building will activate if a power interruption occurs.
example.zh: 如果停電的話，大樓裡的緊急照明燈就會亮起來。

example.en: The city suspended its bus service during the typhoon.
example.zh: 颱風期間，城市暫停提供公車服務。

example.en: Anyone who does business should retain a lawyer.
example.zh: 經商人士皆應聘請一位律師。

example.en: I decided to pursue a career in information systems after completing my university studies.
example.zh: 完成大學學業之後，我決定從事資訊系統相關的工作。

example.en: The project has absorbed all of our department's resources.
example.zh: 這項企劃吸納了我們部門的所有資源。

example.en: The president has no heir to inherit his business.
example.zh: 董事長沒有接班人可繼承他的事業。

example.en: The economy began thriving only after a long period of negative performance.
example.zh: 歷經長期的景氣低迷後，經濟開始蓬勃發展。

example.en: The company has emerged as our strongest competitor in computer games.
example.zh: 這間公司已成為我們在電腦遊戲領域最強大的競爭對手。

example.en: We hope this new venture will generate a lot of revenue.
example.zh: 我們希望這個新事業能產生巨額收益。

example.en: The doctor prescribed me medication for high blood pressure.
example.zh: 醫生給我開了高血壓的藥方。

example.en: Ray's team devised a new method for managing the inventory.
example.zh: 雷的團隊設計出一套管理庫存的新方法。

example.en: The IT company tailors its solutions to specific company requirements.
example.zh: 那間資訊科技公司依照各公司的特定需求制訂解決方案。

verb.meaning_zh: 客製化，依客戶要求訂製

example.en: Allen is surrounded by paperwork every day and never seems to get things done.
example.zh: 艾倫每天被文書工作包圍，似乎永遠沒有做完的一天。

example.en: Olivia's fine work reflects her intelligence.
example.zh: 奧莉維亞傑出的工作成果反映出她的聰明才智。

example.en: The president persists in his plan to move the headquarters to the city center.
example.zh: 董事長執意按照他的計畫，將公司總部遷到市中心。

example.en: The scientists plan to explore every possibility of life on Mars.
example.zh: 科學家試圖探索火星上存在生命體的各種可能。

example.en: Hamwell Store clerks strive to answer all shopper questions.
example.zh: 漢威商店的店員努力回答所有顧客提出的問題。

example.en: Robert was told that he should interact more with his colleagues.
example.zh: 羅伯特被提醒要多跟同事互動。

example.en: My boss will accompany me to the client's office.
example.zh: 老闆會陪我去客戶的辦公室。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 散步，閒逛 / 名 散步

example.en: The couple strolled down the street toward the Seine.
example.zh: 那對夫妻沿著街道一路散步到塞納河畔。

example.en: CEO Michelle Sykes will preside over the annual shareholders conference.
example.zh: 米雪．賽克斯執行長將主持年度股東大會。

example.en: The NPO is soliciting donations to raise and train guide dogs.
example.zh: 那個非營利組織正在募集捐款以飼養並訓練導盲犬。

example.en: We are sorry, but you aren't authorized to access our website.
example.zh: 我們深感抱歉，但你並未取得造訪本網站的授權。

example.en: A plan to develop a new material has been endorsed by the board of directors.
example.zh: 開發新材料的計畫已經獲得董事會的認可。

example.en: Our company gives awards for ideas that are implemented.
example.zh: 我們公司為付諸實行的點子提供獎勵。

example.en: The car maker merged with its competitor after months of negotiations.
example.zh: 經過數月的協商後，那家汽車製造廠商跟競爭對手合併了。

headword.meaning_zh: 動 達成協議；密封 / 名 印章；封（印）

example.en: We finally sealed a deal with the city government.
example.zh: 我們總算和市政府達成協議了。

example.en: Exhibitors at the International Telecom Show unveiled several interesting consumer services.
example.zh: 參展廠商在國際電信展上首次推出幾項有趣的顧客服務。

example.en: Customers may have orders expedited through an extra €5 charge.
example.zh: 顧客只要多付 5 歐元即可加快訂單完成速度。

example.en: Mr. Forester deferred paying the bills until he got paid.
example.zh: 佛瑞斯特先生延遲繳納帳單，一直等到拿到薪水才付清。

verb.meaning_zh: 延後還款；重新安排時間

example.en: The corporation incurred substantial losses during the stock market crash.
example.zh: 這間公司在股市崩盤期間蒙受巨大損失。

example.en: Jan was always exposed to classical music as a child.
example.zh: 珍小時候常常接觸古典音樂。

example.en: The government imposed a new tax on goods and services.
example.zh: 政府對商品與服務課徵了一項新稅。

example.en: The secretary classified the documents by level of importance.
example.zh: 秘書將文件依重要程度分類。

example.en: Assembly line 7 resumed operating in the display factory, after some repairs.
example.zh: 經過修理之後，7 號生產線在展示工廠重新恢復運作。

example.en: Matthew discarded the file and couldn't retrieve it.
example.zh: 馬修刪除了檔案，沒辦法復原。

example.en: Most of the staff found it difficult to conform to the company's policy.
example.zh: 絕大多數的員工認為很難遵守公司的規定。

example.en: The museum waives the admission fees for city residents.
example.zh: 博物館免除市民的門票費用。

example.en: The rule forbids loitering on the museum grounds.
example.zh: 這項規定禁止民眾在博物館內遊蕩。

example.en: Larry's license was revoked after the traffic accident.
example.zh: 賴瑞出車禍之後，駕照被吊銷了。

example.en: I can squeeze that appointment in at three tomorrow.
example.zh: 我可以吧會面時間擠在明天下午 3 點。

example.en: An oil shortage will drive up gas prices and compel fuel conservation.
example.zh: 石油短缺將使得油價飆漲，迫使人們節約使用燃料。

example.en: The public relations spokesperson dismissed rumors that the firm had financial problems.
example.zh: 公關部門的發言人駁斥了公司面臨財務問題的傳言。

example.en: Please discard recyclable trash in the bins provided.
example.zh: 請將可回收垃圾丟進所提供的垃圾桶。

example.en: Our new line of sport shoes incorporates the latest trends.
example.zh: 我們的新款運動鞋系列融入了最新潮流。

example.en: After the merger, the board worked hard to integrate the corporate cultures of both firms.
example.zh: 雙方企業合併之後，董事會不遺餘力，欲將雙方的公司文化融為一體。

example.en: Ms. Flores always embraces a charitable cause and works hard to raise funds.
example.zh: 佛羅瑞絲小姐總是熱衷於慈善事業並努力募款。

example.en: A series of investments has enhanced our status as a leading biochemical manufacturer.
example.zh: 一系列的投資已然提高我們的地位，成為生化產業製造商的領導者。

example.en: Our production facilities across Europe will be consolidated in the new plant in Poland.
example.zh: 我們在歐洲各地的生產設施將併入波蘭的新廠房。

example.en: The firm penetrated the computer market with an affordable new model.
example.zh: 那間公司以平價的新機型打入電腦市場。

example.en: I've accumulated enough frequent flyer miles to travel from Tokyo to London for free.
example.zh: 我已經累積了足夠的飛行里程數，足以從東京免費飛到倫敦。

example.en: The board approved a plan designed to stimulate employee interactions.
example.zh: 董事會核准一項促進員工交流的計畫。

example.en: I don't think we can deduct the cost of this cruise as a business expense.
example.zh: 我覺得我們應該無法把乘船遊覽的費用當成商旅費扣除。

example.en: The software detected a virus in the computer system.
example.zh: 這款軟體檢查出電腦系統裡有病毒。

example.en: The goal of our program is to foster children's interests in science.
example.zh: 我們計畫的目標是培養孩子對科學的興趣。

example.en: The trader asserted his innocence in the scandal.
example.zh: 那名商人堅稱自己在這場醜聞中是清白的。

example.en: The city plans to demolish some of its older buildings.
example.zh: 政府計畫拆除這座城市的某些老舊建築。

example.en: The department exhausted its budget before the end of the month.
example.zh: 該部門在月底前就花光了預算。

example.en: To prevent air quality from deteriorating, the state excludes polluting businesses.
example.zh: 為了避免空氣品質惡化，州政府將造成污染的企業趕了出去。

example.en: I'm afraid you might be distracted by the renovation work this week.
example.zh: 我怕這週的裝修工作可能會干擾到你。

phrases.meaning_zh: 將 A 歸因於 B

example.en: The staff attributed the failure of the project to a lack of preparation.
example.zh: 員工將企劃的失敗歸因於準備不足。

example.en: A fitness center membership eliminates the need to pay daily entrance fees.
example.zh: 具備健身房會員資格即免付每日入館費用。

example.en: This new drug alleviates cold symptoms quickly.
example.zh: 這款新藥能迅速減輕感冒症狀。

example.en: The local residents were evacuated due to the forest fire.
example.zh: 由於發生森林大火，有關當局疏散了當地居民。

example.en: Over 300 wind turbines are scattered across the windy area near the ocean.
example.zh: 300 多台風力發電機四散在近海的多風地帶。

example.en: Bill was reprimanded by his supervisor for failing to arrive at work on time.
example.zh: 比爾因為上班遲到被主管訓斥了一頓。

example.en: Kirsten had to look hard for a file she misplaced.
example.zh: 克絲汀得努力找出之前亂放的一份文件。

example.en: Although the economy is improving, the exchange rate continues to fluctuate.
example.zh: 雖然經濟正在好轉，但匯率依然持續波動。

example.en: The festival culminated in live music, a costume parade and sword fighting.
example.zh: 這場慶典在現場的音樂演奏、變裝遊行和劍術格鬥中達到最高潮。

example.en: Pollution and global warming are jeopardizing the agricultural industry.
example.zh: 污染和全球暖化正危害著農業。

example.en: The new taxes would aggravate the already bad economic situation in this country.
example.zh: 新稅讓該國已經惡劣的經濟狀況雪上加霜。

example.en: We've digressed from the topic, so let's get back on the right track.
example.zh: 我們已經離題了，現在回到正題吧。
